name: Visibilty 1
definition: Specifies the details of the visibility of the creditor enrolment as shown to the debtors.

StartDate.name: Start Date
StartDate.definition: Start date when the information will be shown to the debtors.

EndDate.name: End Date
EndDate.definition: End date when the information will be shown to the debtors.

LimitedVisibility.name: Limited Visibility
LimitedVisibility.definition: Indicates whether the information is shown to the debtors or not.||Usage: when absent, the default value is no limited visibility (false).
